Karbal day Musafir nu Roo Akhdi raee sughra

Koi Akbar nu jaa k akhy Odhi behan dukhiyaari

Takdi paee ay Raah

Koi das dy jaa k AKBAR nu k Vichri SUGHRA

Hay Vichri SUGHRA

Raee Behnaa nu tak k daway Dua ay

inj naa howay

Koi Veer toon Judaa

Andaa har saah jandaa har Saah Meri Tasbeeh hoya

Hay Tasbeeh Hoya

Inj har saah dy Naal Do Do Waari

Veer AKBAR main

Tera Naam Leya

Meri Akhiyaan Teri Rahwaan

Naal Mantaan deeway

Hay Mantaan deeway

Aihoo reh gaee ay Meri Qismat AKBAR

Rooz rondi aan

Tak ky Taiz Hawaa

Koi apna na jithy howay othy jeewaan kiwaain

Hay jeewaan kiwaain

Menu kaindy ny Loog Yasrab walay

hun Yasrab vich

Tera kon reyaa

Tery hisy Veer Aya way sang BaBay daa

Hay Sang babay daa

Mery hisay ch aiyaan Tangaan Hareeh khaali wehray

Ty Tera Naqash e Paa

Reconstructed all 28 lines in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. The Punjabi grammar throughout the verses supports the `pa-Arab` classification. Both versions use the same three-line opening and five numbered stanzas.

The readings of “Raee” in stanza 1 and “Hareeh” in stanza 5 are uncertain. I rendered them as `رہی` and `ہریہ`.
